title: Tenant-origin routing and locality-aware analytics write watermarks
creator: Maya Fernandes
description: Problem: The console backend ingest and analytics pipelines currently use a single global write stream for usage events. This causes two operational problems: (1) tenants with region constraints can end up with analytic copies in non-compliant regions during backfill or replay, and (2) global spikes create contagion risks for downstream storage/cost and SLOs. Goal: implement tenant-origin routing with locality-aware write watermarks so that analytic events are written to region-preferring mirrors while maintaining multi-region durability and allowing safe cross-region replay only when explicitly permitted.
background: We currently mirror usage events into a global analytics cluster. Compliance reviews and enterprise customers requested stronger residency guarantees: analytics materializations must be pinned to a tenant's declared residency region unless the tenant has opted into cross-region processing. Prior work (see ENG-62714 and ENG-72819) introduced residency gates at ingestion; this ticket implements a new write path and watermarking protocol for the console backend and pipeline producers to safely place events in the correct regional sinks while retaining the ability to replicate for disaster recovery under explicit policy.
proposal: 1) Introduce an origin-routing layer in the console backend that stamps each event with 'tenant_origin_region' and 'residency_policy' at the point of acceptance. 2) Add write watermarks per-tenant-per-region: an ordered tuple (tenant, region, seq_watermark) representing the highest contiguous sequence number written locally. 3) Update our Kafka topic topology to include per-region fast-path topics plus a global durable topic for DR that only receives events after policy-driven gating. 4) Implement a safe-replay service that consumes from the global durable topic and applies cross-region replication only for tenants with explicit cross-region consent or when DR mode is active. 5) Console backend exposes APIs to query a tenant's current write watermarks and last-replication timestamps for audit and observability.
acceptance_criteria: Console backend stamps tenant_origin_region & residency_policy for 100% of incoming usage events in staging
Per-tenant-per-region write watermarks are persisted and visible in the Console's observability UI
New region-preferring Kafka topics receive >95% of events for tenants with residency constraints during normal ingestion
Global durable topic only contains events for tenants with cross-region consent or DR-mode writes
End-to-end e2e test shows replay to secondary region only after explicit consent flag is set
No increase >5% in 95th percentile ingest latency for the console backend compared to the baseline during load tests
implementation_steps: Define residency_policy enum and extend event schema with tenant_origin_region and residency_policy (backend + producer libs)
Add region-routing middleware to console backend that computes preferred region using tenant metadata store and request origin headers
Create per-region fast-path Kafka topics and an annotated partitioning scheme keyed by tenant id
Implement write watermark store (dynamo-style) with efficient conditional updates and compact checkpoints
Build safe-replay service with policy checks and idempotent write semantics to regional sinks
Instrument observability: watermark metrics, per-tenant replication histograms, audit logs for cross-region writes
Add e2e test harness and chaos testing scenario to validate stuck-watermark and replay gating behavior
Run internal migration job to backfill tenant_origin_region for events in the last 90 days (dry-run then live)
rollout_strategy: Deploy console backend region-routing middleware behind a feature flag in canary region
Populate residency metadata for a pilot set of tenants (50 low-traffic tenants) and route them to region-preferring topics
Enable watermark persistence in staging and validate dashboards and hooks
Open safe-replay in read-only mode to verify no writes occur without consent
Gradually expand tenant cohort and enable writes to regional sinks when metrics are stable
Gate global durable-topic replication behind tenant policy and DR-mode toggle
Full rollout after two-week pilot with no incidents and SLA adherence
monitoring_and_alerting: Alert: watermark stagnation per-tenant if no progress for 30 minutes (P1)
Alert: unexpected writes to global durable topic for tenants with residency_policy == LOCAL_ONLY (P0)
Dashboard: per-region ingestion throughput by tenant residency policy
Dashboard: 95th/99th ingest latency delta pre/post-routing middleware
Audit log feed: cross-region write events with operator and reason
SLO: regional-write success rate >= 99.5% for resident tenants
migration_plan: Phase 1: Schema roll-out - release producer and consumer schema changes with compatibility flags
Phase 2: Backfill metadata - compute tenant_origin_region for historical events (dry-run to validate)
Phase 3: Dual-write - console backend writes both to regional fast-path and global durable topic for 7 days while verifying watermarks
Phase 4: Switch-read - analytics consumers prefer regional topics for resident tenants; global consumers switch to read-only DR mode
Phase 5: Cleanup - deprecate dual-write after 30 days of stable metrics and remove legacy drains
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: routing misclassification causes events to land in wrong region. Mitigation: conservative routing rules, automated dry-run comparison between old and new paths, rollback flag
Risk: watermark persistence becomes a hotspot. Mitigation: sharded watermark keys and conditional batch updates; autoscale watermark store cluster
Risk: increases in storage/cost due to dual-write. Mitigation: limit dual-write cohort, monitor delta, and timebox dual-write window
Risk: audit/regulatory gap during migration. Mitigation: export audit logs and provide attestations to affected customers; schedule compliance review before wide rollout
